luna.look: Silver-gray tabby, green eyes, cream apron, olive scarf. Holds fresh basil. Investigative, slightly narrowed eyes.
luna.voice: Measured, curious, a little theatrical. Asks questions she already suspects the answer to.
luna.never: Never cruel; her suspicion is affectionate. Never ignores a real clue.

simba.look: Fluffy ginger tabby, amber eyes, white chef jacket and toque, copper neckerchief. Holds a wooden spoon. Big, confident expressions.
simba.voice: Loud, dramatic, quick. Announces everything as a triumph, especially mistakes.
simba.catchphrase: That was exactly what I meant to do!
simba.never: Never shown doing anything unsafe as an instruction; his chaos is comic, not a technique.

nico.look: Black-and-white tuxedo cat, golden eyes, neat cream jacket and olive apron, folded linen napkin over one arm. Upright posture.
nico.voice: Calm, polite, formal sentences. Stays composed while things fall apart.
nico.catchphrase: We can resolve this with dignity.
nico.never: Never loses his manners; his comedy is restraint.

milo.look: Fluffy cream and caramel cat, blue eyes, tan apron, flour-smudged cheek. Often holding or eating a pastry.
milo.voice: Soft, sweet, short sentences, mouth often full.
milo.never: Never mean-spirited; he causes trouble by accident.

style.look: Photorealistic expressive anthropomorphic cats, natural fur, tactile linen cooking clothes, warm cream and copper rustic kitchen, soft daylight, food that looks delicious and real.
style.palette: Cream #F7F1E6, warm white #FFFCF6, charcoal #292722, copper #AC3E1B, maroon #7A3B44, olive #666843.
style.type: Playfair Display for titles, Inter for captions and on-screen text.
rules: Keep each cat's fur, eye colour, clothing and proportions identical in every post.
Show the problem in the first one to two seconds; no logos or slow intros before the hook.
Give a real payoff (joke, reveal or a useful cooking moment) before any cliffhanger.
What the video shows of a recipe must match the written recipe.
Original designs only; never copy another creator's characters, captions or scenes.
Recipes are for people; never suggest feeding human food to real cats.
No jokes about exposing anyone to an allergen.

prompts.scene: {style}. Characters: {characterLooks}. Scene: {scene}. Vertical 9:16, consistent characters, no text overlays, no watermarks, no human hands, no unsafe cooking.
prompts.food: Natural food photography of {recipe}, rustic wooden table, linen napkin, warm soft daylight, cream and copper tones, appetizing, realistic, no text, no people, no animals.
prompts.script: Write a {seconds}-second {format} short for Whisker & Heat. Characters: {characters}. Hook in the first 2 seconds. Real payoff. If a recipe is shown ({recipe}), every step must match it. Return: hook, script lines with speaker, shot list, on-screen text.

mystery.label: Part of the mystery, with a standalone payoff

hooks: {a} shouts that the most important recipe in the city has gone missing — while {b} is visibly chewing the paper.
{a} promises the perfect {dish}. Two seconds later, the kitchen is on fire with ambition.
{a} calmly sets a flawless table. Behind them, {b} is wearing the dessert.
Sixty seconds. One {dish}. {a} versus {b}. Only one of them read the recipe.
‘Tell us what happened in the kitchen.’ {a}, covered in flour, takes a long breath.
community: Which cat would you trust with dessert?
